stage_b_reviewed_content.statement: A composition of quasi-compact maps is quasi-compact.
conclusions: A composition of quasi-compact maps is quasi-compact.

reason: Quasi-compactness of inverse images of quasi-compact opens is preserved under composition.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement: A closed subset of a quasi-compact topological space is quasi-compact.
conclusions: A closed subset of a quasi-compact topological space is quasi-compact.

reason: An open cover of a closed subset extends to an ambient open cover by adding the complement; compactness gives a finite subcover.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $X$ be a topological space. Assume that
\begin{enumerate}
\item $X$ is nonempty,
\item $X$ is quasi-compact, and
\item $X$ is Kolmogorov.
\end{enumerate}
Then $X$ has a closed point.

reason: Zorn's lemma supplies a minimal closure of a singleton; T0 forces that closure to be a singleton, hence a closed point.

stage_b_reviewed_content.statement: A quasi-compact locally Noetherian space is Noetherian.
conclusions: A quasi-compact locally Noetherian space is Noetherian.

reason: A compact locally Noetherian space has a finite Noetherian neighbourhood cover and hence is Noetherian.
